terra.problem: The stamp pun makes the LORD inscribing His law on hearts the subject of a joke.

The explanation broadens the promise to no longer teaching a neighbor at all. The verse specifies teaching a neighbor or brother to know the LORD. It also says the knowing comes from Him, which the verse does not state.
Saying they will not need teaching broadens the verse. It says they will no longer teach a neighbor or brother to know the LORD.
The joke compares the LORD’s promise to remember sins no more with Papa Dorin’s faulty memory, making the promise part of the joke.
The preceding verse does not say they broke the old covenant. That is stated in verse 32.
The explanation states that nobody can measure the heavens. The verse gives this as a condition without stating that it is impossible.
The explanation states that no one can measure the heavens and search out the earth’s foundations. The verse gives these as conditions without stating that they are impossible.
The explanation calls the condition something nobody can do. The verse does not state that it is impossible.
Jeremiah 31:40 does not end the Book of Restoration, which continues beyond this passage.
